lms_sin.L1.source: rad -= 2 pi while rad > 2 pi; rad = 2 pi k / 20 with k <= 200 (lms.c main), so at most 9 subtractions

lms_sin.L2.source: rad += 2 pi while rad < -2 pi; every argument is non-negative

lms_sin.L3.source: Taylor series of sin with |rad| <= 2 pi after normalization; the term of degree 25 (13th iteration) is below the 1e-5 stopping tolerance

gaussian.if1.then.L1.source: rejection sampling (acceptance probability pi/4) driven by the kernel's fixed-seed generator, so the trial count is the same in every run; 16 is an upper bound on the observed maximum, to be replaced by the value measured in the campaign
